purpose: Make each Unit Bank a downstream-complete machine-readable handoff.
downstream_goal: Notes, Practice, Activities, Warm-Ups, Exit Tickets, Reviews, Summatives, Performance Tasks, Quick Check variants, and Progress/Portfolio practice links should be buildable without re-authoring, re-solving, scraping HTML, or guessing routing.
visible_teacher_key_policy: Human-readable Bank HTML may keep routine teacher answers/solutions collapsed or omit them when the machine handoff retains the canonical answer data needed downstream; evidence-bearing/secure resources still retain scoring/evidence data in structured files.
final_bytes_rule: After all generation/repair/postprocessing, deterministic audit must compare final HTML articles, mapping rows, bank_data IDs, manifest routes, and figure/table/export dependencies.

i_can_handoff.rule: unit{U}_i_can_map.csv is the downstream routing/evidence address book. It must contain one row per exact I-can and the evidence design fields required by the I-can-first contract.

conditional_item_fields.correct_choice: Required for selected-response items; may be blank for constructed response.
conditional_item_fields.summative_version: Required/filled for secure Summative items; blank is allowed elsewhere.
conditional_item_fields.task_architecture: Required for secure evidence and recommended for all canonical items.
conditional_item_fields.estimated_time_sec: Required for Summative timing QA and recommended elsewhere.
conditional_item_fields.wtc_frq: Required and true for WTC items; blank/absent elsewhere.
conditional_item_fields.wtc_shared_stimulus: Required and true for WTC items.
conditional_item_fields.wtc_frq_focus: Required non-empty list for WTC items; records the FRQ breakdown moves practiced.
conditional_item_fields.coverage_role: Required value wtc_frq_practice for WTC items; WTC is excluded from current-Unit I-can coverage.

canonical_field_rules.figures: Canonical structured list. Each student-facing figure entry follows contracts/student_figure_answer_neutrality_contract.json. Do not use figure_files as a substitute for figures metadata. Inline SVG is not exempt: represent inline SVG in figures[] with render_mode=inline_svg plus the same student_evidence_role/answer_neutrality metadata; file may be omitted for a true inline SVG record.
canonical_field_rules.tables: Canonical list of structured table/data assets when separate from student_html; use [] when none. An HTML <table> may also carry the actual representation, but the field still exists.
canonical_field_rules.security_level: Canonical field name. Do not substitute security/data_security aliases in final Bank JSON.
canonical_field_rules.dok: Per-item DOK is required. A broad I-can natural_dok_range does not replace item-level DOK.
canonical_field_rules.evidence_point_id: Required per item for downstream evidence routing; use a stable explicit ID, not a blank placeholder.
canonical_field_rules.supporting_i_can_ids: Always present as a list; [] when the item has no genuine supporting I-can.
canonical_field_rules.source_basis: Item-level provenance; concise and truthful, not a unit-wide boilerplate sentence.
canonical_field_rules.audit_status: Required per item. Allowed exact values: NEEDS AUDIT, KEEP, CLEAN, REBUILD. Fresh Bank items initialize to NEEDS AUDIT; a materially edited item resets to NEEDS AUDIT until re-audited.
canonical_field_rules.wtc: WTC content i_can_id may resolve to any Unit in the course-wide I-can index. It is provenance/teacher metadata, not current-Unit coverage. WTC-specific conditional fields must make FRQ form and coverage exemption explicit.
canonical_field_rules.question_design: Required object linking the finished item to its pre-authoring design slot. Must include slot_id, structure_id, wording_profile, response_mode, representation_mode, parallel_family, and variation_axes. DOK/Bloom are derived after authoring and are not preselected design quotas.
canonical_field_rules.question_family_id: Semantic evidence-family identifier. Do not encode Summative version/question number or destination slot merely to manufacture uniqueness.

teacher_html_view_rule: All three teacher views render from the same canonical item objects. unit{U}_resources.html is a stacked resource-sequence view, not a second Bank database.

question_design_handoff.link_rule: Every canonical item question_design.slot_id resolves to one planned slot in the design map.
